title: I saw the Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) wearing two green garments
hadeeth: Abu Rimthah At-Taymi (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: I saw the Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) wearing two green garments.
attribution: Narrated by At-Termedhy - An-Nasaa’i - Narrated by Abu Daoud - Narrated by Ahmad - Ad-Daarimi
explanation: Abu Rimthah (may Allah be pleased with him) reports that he saw the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) wearing green garments.
hadeeth_ar: عن أبي رمثة التيمي رضي الله عنه قال: رأيتُ رسولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وعليه ثَوْبَانِ أَخْضَرَانِ.
explanation_ar: يخبر أبو رمثة رضي الله عنه أنه رأى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وعليه لباس أخضر.
attribution_ar: رواه الترمذي وأبو داود والنسائي في السنن الكبرى والدارمي وأحمد
